pages.ld_description:
Four Volvo Olympians were delivered in the new Railink branding from Walter Alexander bus builders in Northern Ireland to Dublin bus in mid-1999.
The registration numbers were 99-D-517, 99-D-518, 99-D-519 and 99-D-520, with a fleet number of RV 517, RV 518, RV 519, and RV 520 respectively.
This model is:  RV517 (99-D-517) with the route 90 – Connolly Station

1:76 model of the Volvo Alexander Olympian double deck bus with unique Dublin Bus body style and details.
Wealth of separately applied parts and detail.
Fully detailed interior
Accurate destination displays featuring Irish translations where applicable
Undercarriage detail including exhaust and engine
Flush glazing
Steerable front axle
Limited production run
